dependencyDirection.description: transport/adapters -> domain services -> storage/migration kernel -> shared contract/types leaf

src/local.rs.scope: Generation composition and activation transitions extracted 2026-08-09 as src/generation_activation.rs (LLP 0225 §4 first slice).
The remaining ~30.7k-line unassigned local runtime: lifecycle, auth wiring, invocation, watches, and orchestration behavior awaiting later extraction slices.

src/manifest.rs.scope: The shared contract/types leaf scope: language-neutral schema, wire, and generation shapes that other subsystems import downward.
Subsystem-coupled residue (identity, vector, push, assets, auth helpers) still colocated here pending extraction.

uncertainAssignments.src/agent_safe_publication.rs: Publication is generation-adjacent, but its final extracted owner may differ from generation activation.
uncertainAssignments.src/ask.rs: Near-data AI provider execution is an application service; its current SecretRedactor import from generation-adjacent config is frozen residue pending a lower shared redaction shape.
uncertainAssignments.src/auth/admission.rs: Admission epochs fence live work so they sit with the sync engine, though they also gate batch services.
uncertainAssignments.src/auth/deployment.rs: Only generation/deployment activation behavior is assigned here; the remaining auth owner map is intentionally unresolved.
uncertainAssignments.src/auth/descriptor.rs: A pure authority-descriptor type placed on the leaf; its admin/invocation type imports are frozen upward residue to invert by moving those shapes down.
uncertainAssignments.src/auth/handshake.rs: Pure wire/availability computation placed on the leaf; the lease-availability import is frozen residue pending a leaf-side availability shape.
uncertainAssignments.src/auth/invocation.rs: Per-request authority engine placed with the sync engine; storage guards still call up into it, which the owner-2 typed-operation program is expected to invert.
uncertainAssignments.src/auth/lifecycle.rs: Catalog activation/maintenance placed with background services; activation ordering is coordinator-adjacent and may migrate when owner 1 absorbs auth publication.
uncertainAssignments.src/auth/mod.rs: Namespace-only umbrella with zero dependency edges; assigned to the leaf so future re-export edges stay downward for every caller.
uncertainAssignments.src/auth/provider.rs: Session-family core placed with the sync engine to keep coordinator/fence/invocation edges same-owner; its maintenance lanes may later split toward background services.
uncertainAssignments.src/auth/rehearsal.rs: The closed auth-rehearsal wire vocabulary and carrier-validation grammar are contract-leaf concerns; its current ServerProfile conversion is frozen upward residue for a later leaf-side profile shape.
uncertainAssignments.src/auth/runtime.rs: Serve-time provider composition placed with transport adapters because only server/cli compose it; it is not itself a wire adapter.
uncertainAssignments.src/bench.rs: Bench harness placed with transport like the bin harnesses that drive it; telemetry_bench read into it is frozen residue.
uncertainAssignments.src/conformance.rs: Declared-vs-captured conformance placed with the kernel because every current edge is then downward; it reads like a diagnostics service more than kernel code.
uncertainAssignments.src/data_tier.rs: Treated as a contract/profile type leaf pending extraction of any behavior residue.
uncertainAssignments.src/exec_guard.rs: Imperative debug-build thread sanctions placed on the leaf purely for dependency direction; every layer including the kernel calls it.
uncertainAssignments.src/live_wire.rs: Treated as the language-neutral wire leaf even though its current file may retain sync-coupled behavior.
uncertainAssignments.src/local.rs: Mixed hub: generation-activation behavior is targeted for owner 1, but file-level analysis leaves the current module unassigned until extraction creates a real boundary.
uncertainAssignments.src/local/inspection.rs: Inspection DTOs over push/telemetry placed with background services; revisit when the local.rs remainder is placed.
uncertainAssignments.src/local/live_protocol.rs: Live subscribe/resume DTOs placed with the sync engine; the completeness-receipt import is frozen residue pending a leaf-side shape.
uncertainAssignments.src/local/receipt_log.rs: Connection-scoped subscription receipt rings placed with the sync engine; zero dependency edges either way.
uncertainAssignments.src/manifest.rs: Types are assigned to the shared contract/types leaf; higher-level subsystem residue remains to be extracted, so this whole-file assignment is provisional.
uncertainAssignments.src/migration_presentation.rs: Placed with migration for the first ratchet; presentation behavior may later move to an adapter.
uncertainAssignments.src/replication.rs: LLP 0188 self-hosted async replication lane placed with background services (an async lane over kernel snapshots); its frontier/stream coupling may argue for the sync engine as it matures.
uncertainAssignments.src/runtime.rs: Handler-VM host placed with transport adapters (server/cli/workerd compose it); a future dedicated execution owner could claim it.
uncertainAssignments.src/search/fixtures.rs: Test-fixture module assigned to its subject owner (kernel) because the gate has no test category.
uncertainAssignments.src/spike_trace.rs: Env-gated JSONL instrumentation for the LLP 0191 OQ4 live-query spike, placed with the sync engine it instruments; retire the entry if the spike module is removed.
uncertainAssignments.src/telemetry_contract.rs: Treated as a contract leaf; telemetry behavior remains under background services.
uncertainAssignments.src/vector/acceptance.rs: Acceptance-test module assigned to its subject owner (kernel) because the gate has no test category.
